property_summary: After any successful call to setL1BlockValues, the l1FeeScalar state variable must equal the _l1FeeScalar argument passed in the call; the bug sets it to 0 instead, so equality fails when _l1FeeScalar is non-zero.
change_summary: Change the assignment to l1FeeScalar so that it is set to 0 instead of _l1FeeScalar.
